texts.zh:
[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]出于感激，诏令参议院将帝国特许经营权授予[charter_corp.GetName]。这给予他们特殊权力，用以在帝国全境的各处行星上建立分部，而不用和行星的所属国签订商贸协定。

我们可以料想到，这个寰宇企业马上也会在我们下辖的世界上开设分部，建立帝国特许口岸，而我们的司法权在此地不再有效。看来[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]为了拉动经济增长打造了一台强劲的引擎。
texts.en:
After having curried favor with the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], [charter_corp.GetName] has now been granted an Imperial Charter by the Senate. This gives them special dispensation to open branch offices on planets all over the Imperium, regardless of whether they have a commercial pact with the owner.

We can expect the megacorporation to establish Imperial Concession Ports in their branch offices on our worlds soon, where we will have no jurisdiction. It would seem the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has acquired a powerful new engine of economic growth.
